kind: bounded weighted cell-to-point correctness cost and memory diagnostic; inexact baseline
methodology: Identical release probe and dependency locks. Allocator-disabled ABBA twice: four fresh processes/version, one warmup and five samples/case; separate allocator-enabled builds. No agent-owned builds/checks ran during measurement. Actual aggregate process CPU uses checked benchmark-only CLOCK_PROCESS_CPUTIME_ID calls. Input construction, output validation, conditioned tolerance checks and destruction are excluded; cold geometric measures, weight representation, certificates, incidence/count preparation and arithmetic are included. Raw calls include source validation; validated views are created outside timing. Timed output checks use absolute tolerance 1e-12 on bounded conditioned data, not precision acceptance; independent Python Fraction fixtures qualify exact results. Baseline loses adversarial residuals and sometimes rounds one ulp differently, so its timings represent prior correctness cost, not equivalent precision acceptance. Hexahedral grids have 8/16/24 cubed points. Uniform geometry has common weights; stretched x coordinates produce dyadic widths 1.125 and 0.75. Modes are positive quantized, mixed quantized and mixed full 53-bit fractions. Extra vertex/tetra fans have 1/4 points and 128/4096 repeated incident cells. Scalar raw, scalar validated and vector validated grid calls plus two validated fan calls give 78 cases. Tensor/complex, wide fallback CPU, mobile/other hardware and non-hexahedral general geometry CPU are not qualified by these timings. Shared host without controlled affinity/thermal state. CPU is not energy; allocation is cumulative bytes/calls, not peak/live/RSS. No whole-frame or physical-device acceptance claim.
